verdict.rationale: Plausible's own docs say it collects no personal data and that sites using it do not need cookie banners or consent for analytics. Community users corroborate this: they describe a daily-salted hash of IP and user agent used instead of persistent identifiers, and say IP addresses are not stored. Custom events, goals and the Events API cover product-usage tracking, and a first-party proxy option is also documented. Missing for 10: a first-party technical doc explicitly describing the cookieless mechanism, and independent legal or hands-on confirmation of banner-free compliance (one community comment raises a possible IP-address caveat).
